question: What does the narrowing of the bands in shaded region Z represent, and what does it imply?
options: A trend that has ended; prices will stay range-bound
A signal that the prior trend will resume in the same direction
A volatility contraction (squeeze) that often precedes an expansion in volatility; the direction of the breakout must come from other evidence
A bullish signal, because narrow bands mean the stock is consolidating above its average
